html: Ultraviolet (UV) light from the sun can burn skin and, over time, damage it. A few simple habits go a long way.

• Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen and reapply as directed
  • Seek shade during midday hours
  • Wear a hat, sunglasses and protective clothing
Ask a health care professional about any new spot or a mole that changes in size, shape or color.
